question.text: In the network $172.25 .86 .192 / 28$, the fourth octet (in decimal) of the first IP address of the network which can be assigned to a host is $\_\_\_\_$ .

question.text:
Consider the following routing table at an IP router:

\[
\begin{array}{lll}
\text{Network No} & \text{Net Mask} & \text{Next Hop} \\
200.20.128.0 & 255.255.192.0 & R_1 \\
200.20.160.0 & 255.255.224.0 & R_2 \\
200.20.180.0 & 255.255.255.0 & \text{Interface 0} \\
0.0.0.0 & \text{Default} & R_3 \\
\end{array}
\]

For each IP address in Group I, identify the correct choice of the next hop from Group II using the entries from the routing table above.

\[
\begin{array}{ll}
\textbf{Group I} & \textbf{Group II} \\
\text{i) }~200.20.180.55 & \text{a) Interface 0} \\
\text{ii) }~200.20.175.10 & \text{b) R}_1 \\
\text{iii) }~200.20.150.100 & \text{c) R}_2 \\
\text{iv) }~200.20.200.1 & \text{d) R}_3 \\
\end{array}
\]

 

  1. $\mathrm{i-a, ii-c, iii-b, iv-d}$
     
  2. $\mathrm{i-a, ii-b, iii-c, iv-d}$
     
  3. $\mathrm{i-c, ii-b, iii-d, iv-a}$
     
  4. $\mathrm{i}-\mathrm{a}, \mathrm{ii}-\mathrm{c}, \mathrm{iii}-\mathrm{b}, \mathrm{iv}-\mathrm{a}$
question.subject: Computer Networks

question.text: Suppose the congestion window size of a TCP connection is $60$ KB when a timeout occurs. The connection has a round trip time of $50$ msec and uses a maximum segment size of $3$ KB . The time taken (in msec) by the TCP connection to reach a $60$ KB congestion window again is $\_\_\_\_$ .
question.subject: Computer Networks

question.text: Consider a LAN with three nodes $S_1, S_2$, and $S_3$. Time is divided into fixed-size slots, and a node can begin its transmission only at the beginning of a slot. A collision is said to have occurred if more than one node transmits in the same slot. The probabilities of generation of a frame in a time slot by $S_1, S_2$, and $S_3$ are $0.5,0.2$, and $0.1$ respectively. The probability of sending a frame in the first slot without any collision by any of these three stations is $\_\_\_\_$ .
question.subject: Computer Networks

question.text:
In a TCP connection using the Additive Increase Multiplicative Decrease (AIMD) algorithm, the congestion window size at the start of the slow start phase is $4$ MSS and the slow start threshold is $12$ MSS. A timeout event occurs during the sixth transmission. What is the congestion window size at the end of the eleventh transmission?

  1. $7$ MSS
     
  2. $8$ MSS
     
  3. $9$ MSS
     
  4. $12$ MSS
